data.one_liner: Convert strings to colors, hex strings, or hex integers in Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides utility methods to deterministically convert any input string into a Flutter Color object, a hex color string, or a hex color integer.
use_when: You need to generate consistent avatar background colors based on user names or IDs.
You want to map arbitrary string tags to distinct colors automatically.
avoid_when: You need a robust design system with predefined, curated color palettes.
You require complex color manipulation, blending, or contrast calculation features.
strengths: Extremely simple API for converting strings to colors
Supports multiple return types (Color object, hex string, hex int)
weaknesses: Very limited scope with only basic string-to-color functions
Lacks advanced customization for color generation algorithms
